articles.title: 'Wait For Several Times More Powerful Blows': Putin Vows DEVASTATING STRIKES Against Ukraine

The Russian leader said Moscow will respond with even greater force to Ukrainian attacks on Russian territory, declaring that future retaliation would be "several times more powerful." The warning comes after Ukraine said its drone forces struck fuel tankers linked to Russia's sanctioned "shadow fleet" in the Sea of Azov, while Russia has continued large-scale drone and missile attacks across Ukraine. Overnight strikes in Zaporizhzhia killed civilians and damaged residential buildings, according to Ukrainian authorities.
